newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler to see large expansion in Asia - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to see large expansion in Asia - WSJ.

text.p: Chrysler Corp will soon announce plans for a large expansion in Asia, the Wall Street Journal said in Friday's electronic edition.

The company said it planned to look for joint-venture partners to build auto parts and light vehicles, with an eye to possibly setting up plants there to independently assemble prefabricated cars and light trucks, according to the Journal.
The newspaper said Chrysler has taken a more wary approach to worldwide expansion than other U.S. automakers have.

The plan included moving one third of its Asia Pacific operations, or 20 people now based in Auburn Hills, Mich. to a north Asia office in Tokyo and a south Asia office in Singapore, the newspaper said.
Around 24 people in the unit could lose their jobs, take early retirement or find employment elsewhere within Chrysler, the Journal said.
